# Step reference

Every step a workflow can use, with its settings and a starting example.

## Data

### from

**Read data.** Start with an input workbook or a saved table.

Starts the table from a source or a table saved earlier. Leave the sheet blank for the first sheet; a number counts from 1. A CSV file has one sheet, Sheet1.

| Key | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | text | yes | Source. |
| `sheet` | text |  |  |
| `start` | whole number |  | First data row. |
| `trim` | `true` or `false` |  | Trim cells. |
| `skip_blank` | `true` or `false` |  | Skip blank rows. |
| `row_number` | text |  | Row number column. |
| `empty` | text with `{expression}` parts |  | Fail if empty. |
| `columns` | map of name to text |  | Fixed columns. |
| `header.search` | whole number |  | Find header in first. |
| `header.min` | whole number |  | With at least. |
| `header.columns` | map of name to list of names |  | Header titles. |
| `header.fallback` | map of name to text |  | Fallback positions. |

```yaml
- from: {input: input}
```

### save

**Save table.** Keep a copy of the current table for later steps or output sheets.

Keeps a copy of the current table under this name, for lookups and output sheets. It cannot share a name with a source.

| Key | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| (the argument) | text | yes |  |

```yaml
- save: result
```

### append

**Append tables.** Add the rows of saved tables; columns are matched by name.

Saved dataset names separated by commas. Their rows are added below the current table.

| Key | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| (the argument) | list of names | yes |  |

```yaml
- append: [other]
```

### join

**Join tables.** Add columns from a saved table by matching keys.

Adds columns from a table saved earlier where the key columns match. Take chooses and names the added columns; rows without a match get blanks.

| Key | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `with` | text | yes |  |
| `on` | list of names | yes | On columns. |
| `how` | `left`, `inner` |  | Default: `left`. |
| `right_on` | list of names |  | Matching their. |
| `normalize` | `true` or `false` |  | Ignore case and spaces. |
| `suffix` | text |  | Suffix for clashes. |
| `take` | map of name to text |  | Take. |

```yaml
- join: {with: other, on: [Key]}
```

## Rows

### filter

**Filter rows.** Keep rows that match a condition.

Keeps the rows where the condition is true, for example Quantity > 0 or Status != "Cancelled".

| Key | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| (the argument) | row expression | yes |  |

```yaml
- filter: "true"
```

### sort

**Sort rows.** Order rows by columns (stable).

Separate column titles with commas. Choose numeric sorting for quantities and prices.

| Key | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `by` | list of names | yes |  |
| `desc` | `true` or `false` |  | Default: `false`. |
| `numeric` | `true` or `false` |  | Default: `false`. |

```yaml
- sort: {by: [Column]}
```

### dedupe

**Remove duplicates.** Keep one row per key.

Keep one row for each unique combination of these column titles, separated by commas.

| Key | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `by` | list of names | yes |  |
| `keep` | `first`, `last` |  | Keep. Default: `first`. |
| `normalize` | `true` or `false` |  | Ignore case and spaces. |

Short form: `dedupe:` followed by a list sets `by`.

```yaml
- dedupe: [Column]
```

### stack

**Stack columns.** One row per listed column, its value in a new column.

Each row is repeated once per listed column, with that column's value in the new column.

| Key | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | list of names | yes |  |
| `into` | text | yes | Into. |

```yaml
- stack: {columns: [A, B], into: Value}
```

### compare

**Compare tables.** Mark rows added, removed, changed or unchanged against a saved table.

Compares the current table with a saved baseline by key columns and writes a status column.

| Key | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `with` | text | yes |  |
| `by` | list of names | yes | By keys. |
| `columns` | list of names |  | Compare columns. |
| `status` | text |  | Status column. |
| `normalize` | `true` or `false` |  | Ignore case and spaces. |

```yaml
- compare: {with: baseline, by: [Key]}
```

## Columns

### set

**Calculate columns.** Create or update columns with expressions, in order.

Creates or replaces columns, in order, so later ones can use earlier ones. prev("Col") reads the row above.

| Key | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| (the argument) | map of name to row expression | yes |  |

```yaml
- set: {Column: "\"\""}
```

### select

**Select columns.** Choose, rename and order columns.

Keep only these columns, in this order. The left name is the output, the right name the source column.

| Key | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| (the argument) | map of name to text | yes |  |

```yaml
- select: {Column: Column}
```

### rename

**Rename columns.** Give columns new names.

Enter the exact current column title, then its new title.

| Key | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| (the argument) | map of name to text | yes |  |

```yaml
- rename: {Old: New}
```

### fill

**Fill blanks down.** Fill blank cells from the row above.

Column titles separated by commas. A blank cell takes the last non-blank value above it.

| Key | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| (the argument) | list of names | yes |  |

```yaml
- fill: [Column]
```

### drop

**Remove columns.** Remove columns from the table.

Column titles separated by commas. Later steps no longer see them.

| Key | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| (the argument) | list of names | yes |  |

```yaml
- drop: [Column]
```

## Groups

### group

**Group rows.** Summarize rows by key: one row per group.

Separate column titles with commas. Leave Group by empty to total the whole table. Add one summary per aggregate.

| Key | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `by` | list of names |  |  |
| (other keys) | `sum`, `count`, `mean`, `min`, `max`, `first`, `last`, `join`: each a list of names | yes | Summaries. |

```yaml
- group: {by: [Key], sum: [Quantity]}
```

### window

**Calculate by group.** Compute columns per group, keeping every row.

Expressions see group (the group's rows), index (position in group) and size. Leave by empty for one group.

| Key | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `by` | list of names |  |  |
| `where` | row expression |  | Only rows where. |
| `set` | map of name to row expression | yes | Set. |

```yaml
- window: {by: [Key], set: {Column: '""'}}
```

### pick

**Pick rows.** Choose one row per group with ordered rules.

Rules run in order; the first rule with candidate rows chooses. The chosen row is marked true and gets the rule's reason.

| Key | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `by` | list of names |  |  |
| `where` | row expression |  | Taking part. |
| `mark` | text | yes | Mark column. |
| `reason` | text |  | Reason column. |
| `rules` | list of maps with `rows`, `best`, `when`, `reason` | yes | Rules. |

```yaml
- pick: {by: [Key], mark: Chosen, rules: [{rows: 'true'}]}
```

## Control

### if

**If / else.** Run steps only when a table condition holds.

A table expression: it sees rows, table("name"), sheets("input") and config("key").

| Key | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `if` | table expression | yes |  |
| `then` | list of steps | yes | Then. |
| `else` | list of steps |  | Else. |

```yaml
- if: len(rows) > 0
  then:
    - log: Has rows.
  else:
    - log: Empty.
```

### split

**Split rows.** Route matching rows and the others through different steps.

Matching rows run through then, the others through else; the results are appended (then first).

| Key | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `where` | row expression | yes |  |
| `then` | list of steps |  | Then. |
| `else` | list of steps |  | Else. |

```yaml
- split: {where: 'true', then: [], else: []}
```

### log

**Log message.** Write a message to the run log.

Text with {expression} parts, e.g. Loaded {len(rows)} rows. Add a condition to log only sometimes.

| Key | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | text with `{expression}` parts | yes |  |
| `when` | table expression |  | When. |

Short form: `log:` followed by a plain value sets `message`.

```yaml
- log: "Loaded {len(rows)} rows."
```

### fail

**Stop with error.** Stop the run; the message becomes the API error.

Text with {expression} parts. With a condition, the run stops only when it is true.

| Key | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | text with `{expression}` parts | yes |  |
| `when` | table expression |  | When. |

Short form: `fail:` followed by a plain value sets `message`.

```yaml
- fail: {when: 'len(rows) == 0', message: The file is empty.}
```

## Services

### sql

**SQL query.** Query a configured database and save the result.

Parameters are table expressions; a list expands to @p1, @p2… The current table is unchanged.

Needs a configured connection; Mai Studio skips it in local runs.

| Key | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | text | yes |  |
| `save` | text | yes | Save as. |
| `params` | map of name to table expression |  | Parameters. |
| `columns` | list of names |  | Columns. |
| `connection` | text |  | Connection. |
| `batch` | whole number |  | Values per query. |
| `on_error` | text with `{expression}` parts |  | On error, log. |

```yaml
- sql: {query: SELECT 1 AS One, save: result}
```

### rest

**REST request.** Call an HTTP API in batches and save the returned rows.

url, headers and on_error are text with {expression} parts. body sees batch and batch_number.

Needs a configured connection; Mai Studio skips it in local runs.

| Key | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `method` | `GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE` |  | Default: `GET`. |
| `url` | text with `{expression}` parts | yes | Url. |
| `save` | text | yes | Save as. |
| `each` | table expression |  | For each value of. |
| `batch` | table expression |  | Batch size. |
| `body` | table expression |  | Body. |
| `rows` | table expression |  | Rows from response. |
| `columns` | list of names |  | Columns. |
| `headers` | map of name to text with `{expression}` parts |  | Headers. |
| `retries` | table expression |  | Retries. |
| `keys` | `lower`, `upper` |  | Key case. |
| `on_error` | text with `{expression}` parts |  | On error, log. |

```yaml
- rest: {url: 'http://localhost/api', save: result}
```

## Expression helpers

On top of [expr](https://expr-lang.org/docs/language-definition)'s built-ins.

| Helper | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `config("key")` | A config.json value. |
| `norm(v)` | Text, trimmed and in upper case. |
| `trim(v)` | Text without leading and trailing whitespace (JavaScript rules). |
| `str(v)` | The value as text. |
| `num(v)` | The value as a number; an error if it is not one. |
| `toNumber(v, d)` | JavaScript parseFloat with commas ignored; d when it is not a number. |
| `parseFloat(v)` | JavaScript parseFloat; nil when it is not a number. |
| `blank(v)` | True for nil and for whitespace-only text. |
| `truthy(v)` | JavaScript truthiness. |
| `coalesce(a, b, ...)` | The first truthy value. |
| `fields(v)` | The whitespace-separated words of the text. |
| `splitAny(v, ",;")` | The pieces of the text between any of the characters. |
| `replaceRe(v, "^0+", "")` | Replace every match of a regular expression. |
